name: Demo 03: Meeting notes to actions (try it now)

parameters.content:
## Meeting notes to actions: try it now
Click **Test workflow**. It runs on made-up notes and needs no accounts or keys.

Then click each node to see its output:
- **Check notes and build prompt**: the exact prompt the full version sends to Claude.
- **Sample AI reply (illustrative)**: the stand-in reply (see the note below it).
- **Tracker rows**: one row per action, status "Draft, awaiting lead review".
- **Approval row**: the whole draft, with Approved set to FALSE.
- **Draft email to lead**: open the `html` field. It goes to the lead only.
- **Team email (only if approved)**: empty, because nobody has approved yet.

**To see the approval step work:** open **Lead ticks Approved?**, change `const APPROVED = false;` to `true`, and click **Test workflow** again. The team email now appears.

Riverside Community Health Network is fictional.

### Sample AI reply
Illustrative replies written for this demo, standing in for the live Claude call in the full version. They are not AI output.

Everything after this node is the real code from the full version, working on these replies.

// Made-up meeting from sample/form-responses.csv and sample/meeting-notes-2026-10-14.txt.
// The full version reads the Form_Responses tab of your Google Sheet instead.
return [{ json: {
 "lead_email": "amina.example@example.com",
 "title": "Weekly team call",
 "date": "2026-10-14",
 "team_emails": "team@example.org",
 "notes": "Riverside Community Health Network (fictional organisation, made-up data)
Weekly team call, Wednesday 14 October 2026, 10:00 to 10:45
Notes typed during the call by Grace Example. Rough, not edited.

Present: Amina Example (programme lead, chairing), Daniel Sample, Grace Example, Tomas Placeholder, Priya Demo
Apologies: Kofi Testcase

1. Mobile clinic, Northside estate
Amina: the van is booked for Saturday 24 Oct. We still need two volunteers for the blood pressure table.
Daniel said he will ask the volunteer group and confirm names by Monday.
Agreed: we go ahead with 24 Oct, no change of date.
Someone needs to print the new consent forms. Nobody picked this up.

2. Funding report to the city council
Tomas: draft is about half done. Needs the attendance numbers for Q3.
Priya will pull the Q3 attendance numbers from the booking system.
Tomas will send the full draft to Amina before the end of the month.
Question from Grace: does the council want the old template or the new one? Nobody knew. Amina to check? (not confirmed)

3. Translation of leaflets
Agreed: we stop printing the English-only leaflet. All new leaflets go out in English and Polish from November.
Grace will get a quote from the translator, she said "next week sometime".

4. Volunteer training
Long discussion about moving training online. No decision. Daniel thinks half the volunteers do not have laptops.
Open: do we need to lend tablets? Who would pay for them?

5. AOB
Priya mentioned the waiting room heater is broken again. Tomas said he would look into it.
Next call: Wednesday 21 October, same time.
",
 "row": 2
} }];
